c: Open the incident on the classic form; the workspace doesn't offer Propose.
say: Open the incident on the classic form. The workspace doesn't offer propose.

c: In the form's menu, choose Propose Major Incident.
say: In the form's menu, choose propose major incident.

c: Write in Work notes who is affected, what fails and since when; add the Business Impact.
say: In the work notes, write who is affected, what doesn't work, and since when. Add the business impact if you know it.

c: The incident becomes a candidate, its group is emailed, and it appears under Major Incidents › Candidates.
say: The incident becomes a candidate. Its group is emailed, and the major incident managers see it in the candidates list.

c: Child, resolved and closed incidents, and existing candidates, can't be proposed.
say: Child incidents, resolved or closed ones, and existing candidates can't be proposed. Link a child to the major incident instead.
